import html # Predefined template for a blog post. The placeholders are `{title}` and `{body}`. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Safely formats a blog entry for display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized, HTML‑escaped string ready for safe rendering on a webpage. Raises ------ ValueError If either heading or content is empty. """ if not heading: raise ValueError("Heading must not be empty.") if content is None: # allow empty content but disallow None raise ValueError("Content must not be None.") # Escape all user input to prevent XSS or injection via HTML safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the blog entry using the predefined template formatted_entry = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_entry
